name: Dashboard
description: Use the Dashboard to review the company’s current trip activity, monthly performance, service totals, revenue, miles, and billing status.

tasks.title: Read today’s trip counters
tasks.summary: Use the Today cards to review total trips and cancelled trips for the current day.
steps: Use these counters as a quick operating snapshot.

tasks.title: Review monthly activity
tasks.summary: Use the monthly cards to review trip volume, Shared passengers, completed trips, cancelled trips, and No Show trips.
steps: Review Completed, Cancelled, and No Show totals.

tasks.title: Review service performance
tasks.summary: Use the service cards to compare trip count, revenue, and miles by enabled service.
steps: Scroll to the service performance area.
Open or review the card for the required service.

tasks.title: Check billing status
tasks.summary: Use the billing section to review the current invoice, last payment, and payment due date.
